Title: Deployment slots in Azure Websites expanded to 4+1 slots

Body.Content: Azure Web Sites has increased the number of deployment slots for Standard websites to 4 (in addition to the Production slot). This gives you more deployment options, since you can keep multiple versions of your site and alternate between them while continuing to develop. Learn more.
